## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has a test (a bug fix has a test that failed before)
- [ ] UI change: `npx tsx tools/uicheck.ts` reports 0 problems, screenshots below
- [ ] Balance change: `npm run balance` before and after, numbers below
- [ ] Player-facing text is English, plain ASCII, no em-dashes
- [ ] I did not touch `VERSION`, `CHANGELOG.md`, deploy files or secrets
- [ ] I read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)
